review.why: Orchestrates an ML paper pipeline from narrative report to compiled PDF, with external model review and audit gates.
review.summary: Chains plan, figures, LaTeX writing, compilation and a two-round improvement loop. It negotiates an acceptance contract with an external reviewer model before writing, and adds optional proof, claim and citation audits plus a submission gate. It relies on many sub-skills, helper scripts and model servers that are not included.
strengths: An acceptance contract is negotiated before any writing starts
Audits compare numbers with raw result files and citations with their sources
Keeps the PDF of every round for comparison
cautions: Cannot run alone: depends on about a dozen sub-skills, shared references and MCP servers
Runs autonomously between phases by default, for 45 to 90 minutes
Sends the paper, results and prompts to external reviewer models
